title: RT&T trail/lane feature (schema version 1)
description: Contract for every RT&T trail or lane entering the proprietary layer. scripts/rtt/validate.mjs enforces it, reading enums and patterns from this file. Provenance rules (which sources may enter) live in config/rtt/sources.yaml. Changing this file is a schema change: bump schema_version and review the importers.

geometry.description: WGS84 lon/lat. LineString or MultiLineString; every line has >= 2 points and non-zero length.

rtt_id.description: Opaque, permanent identifier assigned when the feature first enters RT&T. Never derived from geometry or from any OSM id, never reused, and unchanged by edits (edits bump version).

osm_derived.description: True if any part was traced, snapped or copied from OpenStreetMap. Such features are quarantined for licensing review and never built into the proprietary layer.
